recognize_zh: 抹片中一群圓核、染色質細緻、核質比高而胞質淡灰藍的原始細胞，旁邊夾雜分葉中性球與有核紅血球；原始細胞無顆粒，形態上屬原始淋巴球，T 細胞系需以免疫表型確認。
features: Cluster of medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with occasional small nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Admixed segmented and band neutrophils and small dense erythroid precursors
Background with scattered cell debris and platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of medium-to-large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and a modest rim of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Scattered segmented and band neutrophils and erythroid precursors are admixed, and the background contains cellular debris. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lineage assignment requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry for cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT.

ddx.vs: B-lymphoblasts express CD19, CD79a and CD10 rather than cytoplasmic CD3, with otherwise identical morphology.
Myeloblasts often show nucleoli, occasional granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof rather than fine blastic chromatin.
